title: Terrain Runoff Pooling
brief: A flood modelling tool slices a terrain survey into a row of columns of equal width and records the ground height of each. After a heavy storm, water settles in the dips between higher ground and runs off past the two ends of the profile.
Implement pooledWaterVolume(height), where height[i] is the ground height of column i, and return the total units of water that stay pooled on top of the columns.
